ayahs.1: Ruin seize the hands of Abu Lahab—and may he himself perish—he who mocked the Message publicly and thought his tribe could protect him from consequences.
ayahs.2: His wealth and whatever he accumulated will not rescue him when the account is due—no inheritance, no status, no emergency fund can pay that debt.
ayahs.3: He will enter a Fire of blazing flame—
ayahs.4: and his wife too, the carrier of thorns—she who spread harm alongside him, fueling hostility against the truth.
ayahs.5: Around her neck will be a rope of palm fibre—a symbol of the burden she chose and the humiliation that follows arrogance against Allah.
